voiceover_emotional_engineering.sentence_structure: Pairs a short statement with a clarifying question or rhetorical punchline (e.g. 'And here's the thing.' [pause 600ms] 'If you have $1 in your pocket...')
voiceover_emotional_engineering.emphasis_strategy: Sudden volume and cadence drop on grave moments ('Money was gone.'), rising pitch on absurd comparisons ('Throwing away a 747 airplane after one flight?!')
